title: Mold Remediation Agreement Signing and Signing Deposit
content:
The Mold Remediation remediation agreement is signed by the property owner or the owner's authorized agent in the same act in which the customer pays the signing deposit through the company's secure payment channel; the customer completes the payment, and staff never take card details. The signing deposit is posted in full as one customer payment on the job on the signing date, a credit card payment carries its surcharge line under the customer payment rule, and a signing deposit of 0.00 posts no payment line.

When another mold job linked to the same claim file has already received insurance proceeds, the part of the mold sublimit left for this job is not shown on this job's records, and the signing is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.

## When the deposit is fixed

The signing deposit is fixed only after the job's charge lines carry the pre-removal asbestos sampling owed on a building built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff. The signing deposit is not worked out until the job's charge lines carry the work-plan visit owed on a tier that requires a protocol.

Put another way, for a building built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff, a deposit figure is not settled while the job's charge lines lack the pre-removal asbestos sampling owed; and on a tier that requires a protocol, it is not settled while they lack the work-plan visit owed.

## Signing and paying: `sign_mold_agreement_2b99f603`

**What it does.** The property owner, or the owner's authorized agent, signs the remediation agreement in the company's secure signing and payment channel and pays the signing deposit there; no card or bank details pass through company staff. On completion the job moves to authorized status with today's date as its signing date. When the deposit is above 0.00 it is posted in full as one customer payment on the job dated today and lowers the balance due; a credit card payment also books a card surcharge line of 2.95 percent of the payment, rounded to the cent half up, which raises the balance due. A deposit of 0.00 signs the agreement without posting a payment.

**Who runs it.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves then runs it through `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `mold_job_id` | The reference number of the scheduled mold remediation job being signed, as the agent reads it from the job lookup and gives it to the customer |
| `deposit_amount` | The signing deposit the agent states, in US dollars, zero or positive, with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent half up |
| `payment_method` | The tender the customer pays the deposit with, exactly one of `credit_card` (a credit card; a card surcharge line is added), `debit_card` (a debit card), `ach` (bank transfer from a checking or savings account) or `check` (an electronic check drawn on the customer's bank account) |

**Return.** A confirmation giving the job reference number, its new status authorized, the signing date (YYYY-MM-DD), and, when a deposit was paid, the payment line's reference number, the payment confirmation number generated by the channel, the tender, the amount paid (USD, 2 decimals), any card surcharge booked (USD, 2 decimals) and the job's new balance due (USD, 2 decimals). A reply starting with "Error:" means nothing was signed or paid because an argument did not meet its stated format: a `payment_method` outside the four values, or a `deposit_amount` that is negative or has more than 2 decimal places.
